title: Data Engineering Coordinator (Remoto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineering Coordinator (Remoto) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa do setor de georastreamento na busca por um(a) Data Engineering Team Lead para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de dados e impulsionar a evolução da sua plataforma. Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil player-coach, capaz de equilibrar uma atuação técnica hands-on com a liderança de equipe, sendo responsável por guiar o time na construção de uma infraestrutura de dados moderna, escalável e orientada ao negócio. É essencial possuir inglês avançado ou fluente para conversação, já que a posição envolve interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais. A contratação é no modelo CLT, com atuação 100% remota.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Atuação Estratégica e Técnica

  • Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features).
  • Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure).
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio.
  • Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis.
  • Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma.
  • Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados.
  • Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos.

Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory).
  • Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights).
  • Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos.
  • Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.

Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos.
  • Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory.
  • Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala).
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP.
  • Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto.
  • Inglês fluente.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse.
  • Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade.
  • Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

Formação e Experiência

  • Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on).
  • Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

title: Coordenador(A) De Engenharia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(A) De Engenharia em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Engenharia que já foi dev, que hoje escolheu liderar e que domina IA agêntica, para construir e liderar a primeira squad Composable.

Este não é um papel comum: você vai entrar em um projeto greenfield, definindo ritos, processos e cultura do zero, enquanto implementa fluxos de desenvolvimento inovadores com agentes de codificação IA. Cada 1:1 que você conduzir, cada feedback ou PDI que estruturar vai transformar a carreira do time e impulsionar resultados estratégicos para o negócio. Você será a ponte entre tecnologia, produto e liderança, ajudando a squad a crescer, aprender e entregar de forma consistente.

Se você se motiva por desafios complexos, gosta de trabalhar próximo aos clientes, de desenvolver pessoas e processos, e quer construir sua carreira em um ecossistema de inovação, vem com a gente!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Conduzir 1:1s estruturados, usando-os como ferramenta de desenvolvimento de carreira e diagnóstico da saúde do time
  • Criar e acompanhar PDIs, apoiando cada dev a evoluir no contexto Composable e na utilização prática de IA agêntica
  • Dar feedbacks diretos e construtivos, incluindo os mais desafiadores, garantindo alinhamento de performance e cultura
  • Organizar e priorizar o trabalho do time, protegendo a squad de scope creep e assegurando entregas consistentes em contexto greenfield
  • Facilitar comunicação clara entre o time, Staff Engineer, especialista de domínio (PM) e direção
  • Criar a cultura da squad do zero: estabelecer ritos, cerimônias e padrões de adoção de IA agêntica no fluxo de trabalho
  • Participar do processo seletivo de novos membros, calibrando perfis e fortalecendo a cultura da squad
  • Usar agentes de codificação IA (Claude Code, Codex ou similar) para apoiar e mensurar resultados com propriedade

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de software
  • Experiência comprovada de gestão de pessoas: condução de 1:1s estruturados, PDI, feedback de carreira e desenvolvimento de liderados
  • Experiência com gestão de performance, incluindo situações desafiadoras, planejamento de ações e tomada de decisões
  • Uso prático de agentes de codificação IA (Claude Code, Codex ou similar)
  • Habilidade de comunicação executiva: apresentar status, riscos e necessidades do time de forma clara para a direção
  • Experiência em contextos de alta ambiguidade ou construção do zero, com habilidade de criar rito e ritmo sem manual

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência em times de produto SaaS, ERP ou plataformas B2B
  • Experiência em squads enxutos e altamente seniores em contexto greenfield
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de software suficiente para dialogar com Staff Engineer e Staff de Produto sem tradução

LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

Regime de contratação: CLT

BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

Vale Alimentação/Refeição iFood

Plano de saúde

Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida

Auxílio Creche

title: Senior Automation Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Automation Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuação no suporte e sustentação da plataforma de automação de workloads, incluindo atendimento de tickets, troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes complexos.
  • Participação ativa no processo de migração da ferramenta Automation Engine (UC4) para o RunMyJobs, incluindo preparação de ambientes, suporte pós-migração e estabilização da aplicação.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts e automações para suporte às operações do time.
  • Suporte à infraestrutura Windows e colaboração com equipes globais para resolução de problemas críticos.
  • Monitoramento e suporte a aplicações críticas, garantindo estabilidade, disponibilidade e melhoria contínua do ambiente.

Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Atuar no suporte técnico e operacional de ferramentas de Job Scheduling e automação de workloads.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado, análise de causa raiz e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.
  • Apoiar a migração e estabilização da plataforma RunMyJobs, garantindo continuidade operacional.
  • Desenvolver scripts e automações utilizando linguagens de programação como Python e Java.
  • Executar atividades relacionadas à infraestrutura Windows e suporte a ambientes corporativos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times globais, incluindo interação com equipes internacionais.
  • Participar de escalas de suporte On Call em finais de semana conforme necessidade do time.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com suporte técnico e troubleshooting de aplicações críticas.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Job Scheduling, como Automation Engine/UC4, Control-M ou Autosys.
  • Experiência com suporte e desenvolvimento utilizando RunMyJobs será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais.
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Azure.
  • Experiência com programação/scripting utilizando Python e Java.
  • Conhecimentos em infraestrutura Windows.
  • Capacidade analítica e habilidade para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Inglês avançado para suporte e interação com times globais.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base.

Mission

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage.
  • Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications.
  • Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability.
  • Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange.
  • Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience.
  • Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.

Whom Are We looking For

We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You'll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.

Key Qualifications

  • Node.Js, TypeScript & React Expertise: Extensive experience with NodeJS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies.
  • TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code.
  • Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand.
  • Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.G., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health.
  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release.
  • Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus.
  • Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team.
  • Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads.
  • AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions.
  • Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus.
  • Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. As the industry's only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.

Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step;
enabling them to unlockvaluable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We've enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we're a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.

Syniti's Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.

THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti's Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.

System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.

Be fully aligned to our core values:

  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.

Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.

About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.

You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.

Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.

Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
    JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.

- Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão

- Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador

- Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio

Sobre o período de estudos:

- Você estuda alemão do Brasil enquanto se prepara para a mudança

- Mentoria em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2

- Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual

2. Reunião com o time da S&W

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops
description:

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.

The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter

Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)

Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Ai Implementation Lead (Technical Pm For Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Implementation Lead (Technical Pm For Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast.

We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped.

Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships.

What you'll actually do

Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate\ "we have this messy thing happening in our operations\ " into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon.

Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time:\ "Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\ " You don't need to write theproduction code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy.

Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review.

Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build.

Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving.

Who you are

You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff.

You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools.

You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business.

You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say\ "that wasn't in the ticket.\"You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it.

This role is for you if

You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call.

You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls.

You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already.

You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company.

This role is not for you if

You want to write production code all day.

You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function.

You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives.

You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week.

You avoid ambiguity.

Location

Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

How to apply

To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy :

  • Your resume
  • A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned

In the Loom, cover:

  • The business problem you were solving
  • Your specific role
  • The technical workflow or architecture at a high level
  • The biggest challenge you solved
  • How you organized and managed delivery

We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English.

  • Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

THE ROLE

This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.

System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.

Be fully aligned to our core values:

  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior altamente qualificado para atuar em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade, com foco na implementação, customização e manutenção de soluções na plataforma Salesforce!!

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

  • Good experience in interacting with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)

  • Good understanding of security practices

Preferred skills

  • Experience with blockchain integration
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts
  • Ruby and Rails experience
  • Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter's identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.To or @tether.Io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.

Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.

About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.

You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.

Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.

Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
    JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Médico Cardiologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Cardiologista em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO CARDIOLOGISTA (desejável RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Cardiologia. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios cardiológicos.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em cardiologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças cardiológicas.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM CARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento.

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em cardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado ;
    ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Cardiologia.

title: Senior Application Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Application Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca profissional sênior de TI com sólida experiência híbrida em arquitetura de aplicações, desenvolvimento e gerenciamento de bancos de dados, com foco particular na integração de sistemas externos por meio de tecnologias middleware como MQ, Kafka, SFTP e CFT. Especializado em ambientes COBOL e DB2 (LUW/zOS), com vasta experiência na integração de sistemas legados e plataformas distribuídas modernas.

Perfil desejado

  • Experiência comprovada no projeto e implementação de soluções de integração ponta a ponta, conectando aplicações mainframe com ambientes de nuvem e Linux (Azure).
  • Sólida experiência em administração de DB2, otimização de desempenho, modelagem de dados e integração de dados, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade de sistemas de missão crítica.
  • Experiência prática com plataformas middleware (IBM MQ, Axway CFT), protocolos de transferência de arquivos (SFTP/FTPS) e streaming de eventos (Kafka), possibilitando a troca de dados robusta e eficiente em ambientes de sistemas heterogêneos.
  • Habilidade em analisar e resolver desafios complexos de múltiplas camadas, abrangendo aplicações, dados e infraestrutura. Experiência em automação, processamento em lote (Control-M/JCL) e modernização de ambientes legados.
  • Reconhecido por uma mentalidade holística, orientada à arquitetura, fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e comunicação eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e de negócios em ambientes internacionais.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • COBOL – experiência prática em desenvolvimento e entendimento de sistemas legados.
  • DB2 LUW e/ou DB2 z/OS:
  • Administração e manutenção
  • Backups e recovery
  • Modelagem e DDL (ex: criação de tabelas)
  • Gerenciamento de índices
  • Performance tuning e análise
  • Carga e extração de dados (Load/Unload)
  • Conhecimentos em Mainframe e sua integração com sistemas distribuídos.
  • Cloud (Azure) e ambientes Linux, incluindo automação via scripting.
  • Control-M / JCL – criação e administração de workflows e agendamento de jobs.
  • IBM MQ – configuração de channels, queues e uso de ferramentas como MQ Explorer.
  • Rocket Enterprise Server.
  • Axway CFT – configuração de fluxos de transferência.
  • Protocolos de transferência: SFTP, FTPS.

Idiomas

  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)
  • Alemão (diferencial relevante)

Outros Requisitos

  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário da Alemanha.

We are looking for a remote, full-time BI Operations Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage the daily health and evolution of the data visualization layer. In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the\ "last mile\" of data-managinguser feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.

  • Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
  • Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
  • Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
  • Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
  • Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
  • Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
  • Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management

  • Work with smart and creative people

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.

Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
    ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
    capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Devops Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience of cloud and DevOps experience to join the core team of our U.S. client. In this role, you will work on both our client's and their clients' software products bridging the gap between development and operations. You will do so by leveraging your expertise in cloud technologies and DevOps principles to design, build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure and applications.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines
  • Develop and implement automated CI/CD workflows
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to operationalize AI/ML models, services, and applications in production environments
  • Establish best practices for infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, reliability, and security
  • Build frameworks and tooling to streamline feature release velocity while maintaining system stability and compliance
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tooling (e.G., code generation, testing automation, AIOps) into DevOps workflows
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization and cost efficiency across distributed systems
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system resilience
  • Advise on DevOps maturity, cloud architecture, and AI-enabled engineering practices

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms (e.G., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures
  • Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.G., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
  • Deep knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.G., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.G., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.G., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer, LLM APIs) and their integration into workflows
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.G., Python, Bash)
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.G., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Experience with security best practices in cloud and DevOps environments (e.G., IAM, secrets management, compliance)
  • Ability to design systems that balance delivery speed with reliability and governance
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Designer De Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco De Talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer De Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco De Talentos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsávelpela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.

Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.
  • Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.

About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. We're a team of curious, talented people, and we're committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay. We're a remote-first consultancy specialising in software engineering, product design, and data. Our teams are based across London, Lisbon, and Porto, and we create digital solutions that continue to deliver value long after our work is done.

About the role:

As a Forward Deployment Engineer at YLD, you'll be part of a client team building innovative products. We're looking for someone curious, passionate, driven, and enthusiastic. You should be skilled in problem-solving and experienced in designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant architectures. You're also an effective communicator and a strong team player. Together with your team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced engineering environment, delivering outstanding results and exciting projects.

Your day-to-day responsibilities can look like this:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust backend and infrastructure systems using Golang and Java with contributions across the broader engineering stack
  • Work closely with client teams in collaborative working sessions, explaining technical decisions and translating complex engineering concepts clearly
  • Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform, and Flux
  • Actively leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and drive engineering best practices

Preferred skills:

  • Strong backend and infrastructure engineering background, with hands-on Golang and Java experience;
  • Experience developing or integrating decentralised systems, data infrastructure, or distributed technologies;
  • Solid command of cloud infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform, and Flux;
  • Actively and meaningfully using AI tools in day-to-day coding practice (not just awareness, but advanced, habitual use);
  • Familiarity with TigerBeetle, YugabyteDB, or Red Panda;
  • Experience in fintech, core banking, or regulated financial services environments;
  • Open to occasional travel to London.

You should apply if you are:

  • Proactive: You take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be asked;
  • A strong communicator: you express technical ideas clearly, in writing and in client-facing conversations, with full professional fluency in English;
  • Confident presenting: you bring a polished, engaged attitude to working sessions and stakeholder interactions;
  • Focused on quality: you care about doing things properly and hold yourself to a high standard;
  • Pragmatic: you make sensible trade-offs and deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments;
  • A creative problem solver: you approach hard engineering challenges with curiosity and ingenuity;
  • Collaborative: you thrive on working within cross-functional, distributed teams and value others' input.

What you'll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business

Our typical recruitment process:

  • 1st Interview with someone from the Talent team (30/45 mins)
  • Technical Interview with our Senior Developers (1h30)
  • Final chat with our Client Partner (30/45 mins)

Get a glimpse of what it's like working at YLD!

Check out our LinkedIn page

We're an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity in all its forms. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, age, marital status, or disability. We also offer a remote-first working environment, with flexible working and work–life balance as standard for all employees.
