title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)

Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time

About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time

Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)

Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only

Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary: Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company's growth and direction
  • Fully remote: work from anywhere
  • PTO: 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day: An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development

Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Tech Lead Reactjs
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead Reactjs em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

(Tech Lead React)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar como referência técnica em frontend, liderando a construção e evolução de soluções digitais com foco em performance, escalabilidade e experiência do usuário. Como Tech Lead React, você será responsável por guiar o time nas decisões arquiteturais, garantir a qualidade das entregas e promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, fomentando um ambiente colaborativo, de aprendizado contínuo e alta performance.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Liderança e Mentoria: Alinhar objetivos, identificar necessidades de treinamento e garantir o
  • nivelamento técnico da equipe.
  • Gestão de Processos: Acompanhar o ciclo de desenvolvimento, mitigar riscos de entrega e
  • apoiar o time de projetos em cronogramas e estimativas.
  • Excelência Técnica: Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis,
  • realizando revisões de código (code review) e garantindo a adoção de padrões de qualidade.
  • Colaboração Multidisciplinar: Atuar próximo aos times de Design e Backend para
  • implementação de interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e otimizadas.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Identificar gargalos de performance no frontend e manter o projeto
  • atualizado com as melhores práticas do mercado.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento frontend.
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript.
  • Domínio profundo de React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API).
  • Experiência prática com o framework Remix.
  • Domínio de Tailwind CSS, além de HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores (SASS/LESS).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git).
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Prática com testes de frontend (Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful e práticas de DevOps/CI-CD.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de design e prototipagem (Figma).

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com infraestrutura em nuvem voltada para frontend.
  • Possuir experiência com ferramentas de teste end-to-end como Cypress ou Playwright.
  • Tiver experiência com Micro-frontends, Design Patterns e Clean Architecture aplicados ao
  • Frontend.
  • Dominar conceitos de Core Web Vitals, renderização no servidor (SSR), hidratação
  • progressiva e estratégias de cache.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Vendedor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vendedor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, Candidata(o)!

Se você é motivada(o), apaixonada(o) por moda, tem habilidades excepcionais de comunicação e é movida(o) por resultados, queremos conhecê-la(o)!

Candidate-se agora e seja parte da Yzy School! A primeira escola de inglês através da MODA!

Como Closer (Executiva(o) de Vendas) você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Conduzir reuniões de vendas com leads qualificados (entregues pela equipe de pré-vendas);
  • Apresentar nossa metodologia exclusiva de ensino de idiomas através da moda, conectando o produto às necessidades do cliente;
  • Contornar objeções com empatia, inteligência e técnicas avançadas de negociação;
  • Realizar o fechamento de vendas (closing), garantindo o atingimento e superação das metas estabelecidas;
  • Gerenciar ativamente o pipeline de vendas e realizar follow-ups estratégicos;
  • Registrar todasas atividades, interações e avanços em nossa ferramenta de CRM padrão;
  • Participar de treinamentos contínuos para desenvolvimento profissional e aprimoramento de técnicas de vendas;
  • Integrar-se aosritos de gestão, fornecendo informações precisas sobre seu progresso, métricas e previsibilidade de fechamentos.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Experiência comprovada na área de vendas em meios digitais, especificamente no fechamento de negócios (Closer);
  • Forte vivência na área comercial com foco em atingimento de metas;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com alto poder de persuasão e escuta ativa;
  • Habilidade paranegociação e contorno de objeções.

Você se destaca se possuir:

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento na área comercial, administração ou afins;
  • Cursos de especialização na área de vendas e negociação;
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de CRM;
  • Experiência comvendas B2C e B2B, preferencialmente no mercado de educação (EdTech) ou moda;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de metodologias de vendas (SPIN Selling, BANT, GPCT, etc.);
  • Conhecimento deinglês ou francês.

Benefícios:

  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em organização em franca expansão.
  • Oferta de treinamentos de alto nível personalizados para os colaboradores.
  • Cultura organizacional focada em resultados, com reconhecimento e recompensas.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e participativo que valoriza habilidades e experiências dos colaboradores.

Demais Informações:

Remuneração fixa + comissionamento agressivo por vendas (variável);

Remuneração a combinar;

description:

Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!

#VemSerVericoder

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações full stack (backend e frontend), garantindo performance, escalabilidade e qualidade
  • Utilizar agentes de IA e ferramentas de AI-assisted development no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software
  • Projetar, implementar e integrar serviços inteligentes baseados em IA aos sistemas existentes
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas, combinando desenvolvimento tradicional com uso estratégico de IA
  • Desenvolver APIs, microsserviços e interfaces modernas para consumo interno e externo
  • Atuar na construção e evolução de integrações entre sistemas (ERPs, CRM, marketplaces e plataformas externas)
  • Trabalhar com fluxos síncronos e assíncronos (REST, mensageria, eventos)
  • Contribuir com decisões de arquitetura, especialmente em cenários que envolvam automação e IA
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software, testes automatizados e qualidade de código
  • Documentar soluções técnicas, integrações e fluxos inteligentes implementados
  • Apoiar na identificação de oportunidades de automação e ganho de produtividade via IA

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência como desenvolvedor Full Stack
  • Domínio em pelo menos uma stack backend (Java ou Node.Js / TypeScript / JavaScript)
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento frontend (ex: Angular, React ou similares)
  • Vivência com uso de IA no desenvolvimento de software, incluindo:
  • Ferramentas de AI-assisted coding
  • Uso de LLMs em aplicações
  • Integração com APIs de IA
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas (monolito, microsserviços e APIs)
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas (REST, mensageria ou eventos)
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Familiaridade com Git e fluxo de versionamento

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com construção ou orquestração de agentes de IA
  • Vivência com frameworks e ferramentas de IA (ex: LangChain, Semantic Kernel ou similares)
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos
  • Experiência com integrações complexas (ERP, fiscal, marketplaces ou CRM)
  • Vivência com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados ou aplicações orientadas a dados
  • Forte cultura de testes automatizados e engenharia de qualidade

Perfil esperado

  • Mentalidade orientada a resolução de problemas com apoio de IA
  • Capacidade de equilibrar desenvolvimento tradicional com novas abordagens baseadas em inteligência artificial
  • Perfil analítico e curioso, com interesse contínuo em novas tecnologias
  • Boa comunicação para atuar em ambientes colaborativos
  • Autonomia e protagonismo técnico

Benefícios:

  • Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;
  • Dia de Folga Adicional: Após 1 ano de empresa, você tem direito a 1 dia extra de folga;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Bônus vinculado ao desempenho e resultado da empresa;
  • Vale Refeição eVale Alimentação: Oferecidos através do Cartão Flash Benefícios, proporcionando flexibilidade no uso;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico: Cobertura abrangente para cuidar de você e de sua família;
  • Seguro de Vida: Proteção financeira para você e sua família;
  • Auxílio Creche: Benefício disponível para colaboradores com filhos de até 71 meses de idade;
  • Total Pass: Acesso a academias para manter o bem-estar e a saúde em dia;
  • Welcome Kit: Receba um kit de boas-vindas com itens essenciais para o seu dia a dia;
  • Parceria com Escola de Idiomas: Descontos para o aprendizado de novos idiomas;
  • Parceria com o Sesc: Direito à Credencial Plena, que oferece acesso gratuito ou com preços especiais a diversas atividades;
  • Desconto na FIAP: Até 10% de desconto em cursos da FIAP para continuar se desenvolvendo.

(Tech Lead React)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Atuar como referência técnica em frontend, liderando a construção e evolução de soluções digitais com foco em performance, escalabilidade e experiência do usuário. Como Tech Lead React, você será responsável por guiar o time nas decisões arquiteturais, garantir a qualidade das entregas e promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, fomentando um ambiente colaborativo, de aprendizado contínuo e alta performance.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento frontend.
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript.
  • Domínio profundo de React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API).

  • Domínio de Tailwind CSS, além de HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores (SASS/LESS).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git).
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Prática com testes de frontend (Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful e práticas de DevOps/CI-CD.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de design e prototipagem (Figma).

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com infraestrutura em nuvem voltada para frontend.
  • Possuir experiência com ferramentas de teste end-to-end como Cypress ou Playwright.
  • Tiver experiência com Micro-frontends, Design Patterns e Clean Architecture aplicados ao
  • Frontend.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS).
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.

Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).

title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Treasury Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company's credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements.

The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus)

- Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries.

- Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure.

- Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements.

- Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines.

- Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements.

- Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts.

- Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations.

- Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees.

- Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled.

- Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure.

- Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region.

Cash Management & Treasury Operations

- Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies.

- Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts.

- Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations.

- Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System.

- Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations.

- Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements.

- Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories.

- Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries.

- Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities.

Stakeholder Management

- Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts.

- Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations.

- Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization.

Requirements

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

Professional Experience

- Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees.

- Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

- Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds.

- Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements.

- Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2).

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Skills & Competencies

- Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.

- Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure.

- Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Languages

- Advanced English (required).

- Intermediate Spanish (desirable).

Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

title: Ai Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Creative Producer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across a diverse range of genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As an AI Creative Producer, you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of voice design and performance across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and expertise in AI Voice design Tools.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

4. AI-driven Innovations and tool adoption

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.

5. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

6. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

7. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

9. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, voice design, post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows.
  • Proven experience working with Pro Tools, Elevenlabs, and similar platforms.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

title: Ai Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Creative Producer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across a diverse range of genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As an AI Creative Producer, you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of voice design and performance across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and expertise in AI Voice design Tools.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

4. AI-driven Innovations and tool adoption

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.

5. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

6. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

7. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

9. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, voice design, post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows.
  • Proven experience working with Pro Tools, Elevenlabs, and similar platforms.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration: 1 year

Employment type: Independent contractor agreement

Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone

Reporting to: Senior Director

Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location

Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

About the Secure Energy Project

The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.

The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.

Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.

You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.

To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.

Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.

We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.

What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.

Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.

Media pitching and spokesperson training

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.

Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31.
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.

About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it.
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side.
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done.
  • You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too.
  • You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on.
  • You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails.
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes.
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.

Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively.
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.

What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

  • Deadline June 1st 9am BST

Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone

Reporting to: Senior Director

Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location

Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

About the Secure Energy Project

The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.

The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.

Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.

You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.

To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.

Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.

We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.

What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.

Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.

Media pitching and spokesperson training

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.

Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31.
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.

About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it.
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side.
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done.
  • You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too.
  • You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on.
  • You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails.
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes.
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.

Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively.
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.

What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Gastroenterologista em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.
  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
    ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Dados - Especialista em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Framework! Evoluímos grandes marcas em todo o mundo com transformação digital e crescemos continuamente através de agilidade, design e tecnologia.

Fazer parte do nosso time é saber que a sua jornada será de desafios reais, de crescimento contínuo e de contato diário com referências em tecnologia. Vem com a gente!

Você decide entre vale-transporte ou vale-combustível, no caso de vagas híbridas e presenciais

Plano de saúde e auxílio odontológico de alta qualidade

Seguro de vida que cobre doenças ocupacionais

Trib Pass para trocar moedas digitais por hospedagens e passagens aéreas com cobertura mundial

Desconto em consultas nutricionais

Knowledge transfer através do Frame KT

Bonificação por indicação de novos colaboradores

E não paramos por aí!

Horário flexível

No dress code

Nas pausas presenciais, fique à vontade para comer pães, bolos e frutas

Ambiente leve, flexível e cultura colaborativa.

E qual será a sua missão na Framework?

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar pipelines robustas, conectando dados de diversas fontes utilizando principalmente ferramentas do ecossistema AWS;
  • Implementar soluções de transformação e enriquecimento de dados escaláveis e eficientes utilizando DBT, garantindo qualidade, rastreabilidade e geração de insights acionáveis para o negócio;
  • Gerenciar integrações, processos de transformação e automações de tarefas usando conectores de dados, APIs SQL, Python e Rest;
  • Utilizar SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Aplicar Spark em cenários de processamento distribuído para grandes volumes de dados, tanto em batch quanto em tempo real;
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia de software, qualidade de dados, documentação e observabilidade das pipelines.

O que é preciso para fazer parte do time?

  • Experiência sólida com serviços AWS voltados para dados, como Athena, S3, Glue e Lambda;
  • Proficiência emSQL, Python, Spark e DBT;
  • Vivência com orquestração de pipelines utilizando Apache Airflow ou ferramentas similares;
  • Conhecimento emarquitetura e modelagem de dados para ambientes analíticos, como Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mart e Data Mesh;
  • Experiência commodelagem de dados relacional e analítica, além de processos ETL/ELT;
  • Vivência com APIs, microsserviços, containers e integrações de sistemas;
  • Conhecimento emboas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo documentação, testes automatizados, monitoramento e clean code;
  • Experiência commonitoramento de qualidade de dados e observabilidade em ambientes AWS;
  • Conhecimento emgestão e otimização de custos em cloud.

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Possuir certificações AWS relacionadas à área de Data & Cloud Engineering, como AWS Cloud Practitioner, AWS Data Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect ou AWS Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Possuir forte orientação analítica e visão de negócio para transformar dados em valor;
  • Demonstrar perfil proativo, colaborativo e com facilidade para atuar em ambientes de alta escalabilidade.

A NOSSA EVOLUÇÃO É CRESCENTE!

E, para acompanhar esse crescimento, precisamos de pessoas que agreguem propondo ideias, soluções e desafios!

Gostou da oportunidade? Vamos juntos e faça parte da nossa história! #vempraframe

title: Desenvolvedor Full Sênior - Líder Técnico
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Sênior - Líder Técnico em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!

A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.

Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Líder Técnico para atuar na liderança técnica, definição arquitetural e evolução de aplicações modernas e escaláveis. O papel exige sólida experiência no ecossistema de microsserviços e APIs, transitando com autonomia entre o backend e o frontend. No ecossistema backend, o desafio envolve o domínio de Node.Js (NestJS) e Java 17+ (Spring Boot), com integrações complexas via REST e SOAP. No frontend, a atuação é focada em React e TypeScript para a construção de SPAs responsivas e componentizadas. Além disso, o escopo contempla a disseminação de boas práticas para o time e a interface com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura básica em nuvem (AWS e CI/CD).

O que você irá fazer:

  • Atuar com autonomia técnica na liderança de times de desenvolvimento e na definição de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações modernas baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços e orientadas a APIs.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas do projeto e apoiar na disseminação de boas práticas de engenharia para a equipe.
  • Garantir a entrega de interfaces responsivas, componentizadas e de alta performance utilizando React e TypeScript.
  • Construir e manter o backend escalável utilizando Node.Js (NestJS) e Java 17+ (Spring Boot).
  • Garantir a integração eficiente e segura entre serviços utilizando APIs REST e SOAP.
  • Apoiar na cultura DevOps, lidando com noções de CI/CD, pipelines, automação de deploy e API Gateway.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada de 5+ anos na área de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento frontend: React, SPA, roteamento, componentização e consumo de APIs.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em TypeScript, CSS e SCSS/SASS para desenvolvimento responsivo.
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento backend com Node.Js (NestJS com estrutura modular, controllers, services, providers e injeção de dependência) e Java 17+ (Spring Boot).
  • Experiência prática na arquitetura de microsserviços e desenvolvimento/consumo de APIs REST e SOAP (JSON, autenticação e integração).
  • Perfil de liderança técnica com excelente capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e mentoria.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimentos práticos e noções em nuvem AWS (infraestrutura básica, serviços de cloud e deploy).
  • Experiência na configuração e otimização de pipelines de CI/CD e gerenciamento de API Gateways.

Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT

Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento de software para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

Inscreva-se agora!

description:

Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior | Vanguarda

A Vanguarda acabou de fechar um grande acordo e está em franca expansão! Estamos aumentando o time de tecnologia para acompanhar esse crescimento acelerado e entregar nossos projetos com excelência.

title: Veeva Support Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veeva Support Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

Job Description

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. This role provides comprehensive technical support and system management across multiple regulatory and document management platforms. Responsibilities include end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs Vaults, encompassing issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive monitoring. The position collaborates with BOT development teams to deliver Veeva RIM API endpoints for automation and integration, and contributes to configuring the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite to ensure streamlined compliance tracking. Acting as the technical point of contact for PleaseReview (both standalone and Veeva-integrated), the role manages user access, configuration, performance optimization, and license administration. Additional duties include setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, lifecycle management of Lorenz docuBridge (including user provisioning and licensing), and support for Lorenz iSubmit installation, configuration, and issue resolution to meet submission standards. The role also involves configuring Word Templates for regulatory workflows, installing and troubleshooting iLovePDF and other document processing tools for high-volume submissions, and managing ServiceNow Request and Incident tickets to ensure timely resolution of customer escalations. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM, working US ET hours.

Compensation:

$20/hr to $25/hr.

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration: 1 year

Employment type: Independent contractor agreement

Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone

Reporting to: Senior Director

Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location

Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

About the Secure Energy Project

The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.

The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.

Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.

You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.

To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.

Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.

We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.

What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.

Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.

Media pitching and spokesperson training

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.

Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31.
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.

About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it.
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side.
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done.
  • You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too.
  • You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on.
  • You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails.
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes.
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.

Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively.
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.

What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

* Professional demeanor and client-facing communication skills

* No experience required

⸻

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

* Reliable computer and connection to the internet required

⸻

Studio58 is a commercial architecture and construction firm focused on creating strategic spaces that help businesses grow. Our work combines design, branding, permitting, and construction coordination to create environments that are both functional and impactful.
